name: vscode-agc-debugger
description: Debug Apollo Guidance Computer programs with yaAGC.

agc.debuggerPath.description:
Path to the yaAGC debugger executable. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder.
Can be overriden in launch.json via `debuggerPath`

agc.dskyPort.description:
Port used by yaAGC for DSKY and peripheral connections.
Can be overriden in launch.json via `dskyPort`

agc.frameworkFolder.description:
Folder name containing the Main.agc framework. When the active AGC source is in this folder, the debugger uses the Main image.
Can be overriden in launch.json via `frameworkFolder`
